title: Muhyo & Roji's Bureau of Supernatural Investigation — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The bleak reading of Muhyo & Roji's Bureau of Supernatural Investigation is also the most testable one. Muhyo & Roji's Bureau of Supernatural Investigation, also known as simply Muhyo & Roji, is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yoshiyuki Nishi. The series ran in Shueisha's shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump from November 2004 to March 2008, with its chapters collected in 18 tankōbon volumes.

Once you see Muhyo & Roji's Bureau of Supernatural Investigation as an adaptation, the mystery mostly evaporates. On June 16, 2019, a second season was announced, with the staff and cast reprising their roles. For the week of June 5–11, the 12th volume of the premiered in seventh place in the list of weekly bestselling manga series in Japan.
